pages.text: Rotational power is the main method of powering a lot of machinery.$(br2)There are several ways to achieve this, which will be laid out here as i discover them.

The earlierst form of rotational power can be achieved with windmills.$(br2)The higher these are placed, the faster they can spin, producing more power.$(br2)Additional blades can be attached to speed them up as well.

A ratiobox can transfer rotational power between windmill, axles, machines, etc.$(br2)Right-click any of it's faces with an axle to change the input/output mode.$(br2)Right-click it with an empty hand to specify its power distribution.
